1.explanation: Both of these files are responsible for rendering the OverflowMenu trigger and its menu items. In OverflowMenu.js the trigger <button> is given a default tabIndex prop and the assistive‐text <span> is rendered with focusable="false". In OverflowMenuItem.js each dropdown item’s <button> also receives a default tabIndex. Removing or making these props optional in these two files will eliminate the unnecessary tabindex and focusable attributes.
1.bug_scenario: When rendering an OverflowMenu from carbon-components-react, the trigger button is explicitly given tabIndex="0" (even though native <button> elements are focusable by default) and the assistive-text <span> is given focusable="false" (a non‐standard attribute on span). These extra attributes don’t break functionality but are semantically incorrect and should be removed or made configurable.

2.explanation: All of the offending defaults are defined in OverflowMenu.js in the React package: the default tabIndex (set to 0) on the <button> toggle is applied around line 219, and the default focusable="false" on the SVG icon and on the <span> label is applied around line 524 via the component’s defaultProps. Removing or parameterizing these props requires changes in this single source file.
2.bug_scenario: When rendering the OverflowMenu component from carbon-components-react, the toggle button is being rendered with an explicit tabindex="0" (even though HTML buttons are focusable by default), and the inner <span> wrapper used for the menu label is being rendered with a focusable="false" attribute (which <span> elements don’t support). While these extra attributes don’t break functionality, they are semantically incorrect and should be removed or made optional.
